summary: Iteration 2: Verified NEW push-notification behavior end-to-end. Backend Expo push register/unregister/test endpoints, idempotent upsert on (user_id, expo_push_token), auto-cleanup of DeviceNotRegistered tokens (real HTTP roundtrip to https://exp.host/--/api/v2/push/send with fake ExponentPushToken[TEST-DEVICE-abcdefghij]), auth guards on all 3 push endpoints, and targeted chat.mention WS routing (only mentioned user receives it; self-mention & unknown handle are no-ops). Coffee round still broadcasts coffee.round + chat.message to all connected clients. Frontend: notifications bell (data-testid=notifications-toggle) toggles to volt-yellow enabled state after grant_permissions, chat-input placeholder updated to 'Message the peloton — @mention a rider', and window.Notification is fired for both coffee.round and chat.mention when document is hidden. Regression flows (login, rides list, RSVP, chat, riders, coffee round) still green. 15/15 backend tests pass, all frontend assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: send_expo_push relies on ordinal ordering of tickets vs. batch messages, which matches Expo's documented behavior — OK, but consider logging the full ticket response for debugging in production.
CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — fine for a public demo, tighten for prod.
push_test returns {ok:false, detail:'No registered devices'} with HTTP 200; consider 404 for stricter semantics (minor).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded users. Test push token 'ExponentPushToken[TEST-DEVICE-abcdefghij]' is auto-cleaned by Expo DeviceNotRegistered path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push infra is verified. If future iterations touch send_expo_push, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_push_and_mentions.py — it covers idempotency, validation, auth guards, real Expo call + DeviceNotRegistered cleanup, and @mention WS routing between two live WebSocket connections. Frontend browser-notification test requires page.context.grant_permissions(['notifications'], origin=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) BEFORE navigation, plus page.add_init_script that shims window.Notification and forces document.visibilityState='hidden'. Trigger the event as a DIFFERENT user (broadcast_except excludes the sender).
